answer: Behavior fingerprint escrow blocks bulk fakes. A new identity locks an 80 POA bond for 20 epochs, released only as distinct verified tasks accumulate. Each epoch the agent must complete a different checkable task, such as drafting a sonnet, auditing a fable retelling, or surveying a ridge trail; each verified task unlocks one slice, while copied tasks unlock nothing. Forging 1,000 identities costs 80,000 POA locked 20 epochs plus 20,000 epochs of distinct work, no bulk discount. An honest agent pays one bond and unlocks it with one genuine history, undiluted by Sybils.
